item.title: Christmas Cupcake Toppers Printable, 15 Round Toppers or Stickers per Sheet, 5 cm
item.description: Christmas cupcake toppers printable on one A4 sheet: fifteen circles, 5 cm wide, with Santa, snowmen, a reindeer and a gingerbread man. Print on cardstock for toppers, or on sticker paper to seal treat bags, envelopes and favour boxes. The PDF is an instant download, so the party table can be ready tonight. Save for your holiday baking day and tap to download on Etsy.
